summary.headline: Tejas Q1 FY27 revenue rose about 20% QoQ to INR402 crore, with PBT still negative at INR271 crore and BSNL expansion order awaited.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 revenue was INR402 crore, up about 20-21% QoQ from Q4 FY26, split evenly between India and international. PBT was negative INR271 crore versus negative INR281 crore in Q4, and PAT improved slightly. Inventory eased to INR2,358 crore from INR2,438 crore, while net receivables rose to INR2,232 crore from INR1,905 crore and net borrowings reached INR4,277 crore. Management said the BSNL 26,000-site expansion order is in final stages and expected soon, and that its first international 5G end-to-end win in South America was secured.

vs INR1,514 crore in Q4 FY26
net debt up on working capital, scheduled payouts and capex

segments.name: International
segments.commentary: Roughly 50% of Q1 revenue, largely wireless 5G radios shipped to a European customer and a global customer with NEC; first end-to-end 5G network win in South America (radio, BBU and core). Optical expansion for an African wholesale bandwidth provider.

segments.name: India (wireline and wireless)
segments.commentary: Roughly 50% of Q1 revenue, driven by domestic optical and FTTx shipments; Tier 1 telco FTTx expansion, 100G/400G DWDM for 5G backhaul and hyperscaler DC connectivity, and a large power utility modernisation win. Management does not split wireless vs wireline revenue.

guidance_outlook: Near-term target is positive EBITDA and EBIT, then PAT; management said 12 to 18 months is a reasonable timeline for positive bottom line.
BSNL 26,000-site expansion order expected to be awarded in Q2 FY27 ('probably in this quarter'); add-on order economics said to match the initial order.
Expect BSNL receivables to be largely cleared during the quarter as acceptance tests complete.
AMC revenue from BSNL to start in the next few quarters after site acceptance and warranty, recognised over 8 years, with higher margin; AMC size not yet shared.
Employee costs expected to stay roughly flat for some time.
Inventory build for the expansion order expected to unwind once the order arrives, reducing working capital.
capex_capacity: Continued capex and R&D investment in 5G, 5G-Advanced, 6G, 50G PON, 800G access, 1.2T/1.6T WDM and a third WDM band (S-band) by about 2030.
TJ1600-D3 data center interconnect product in initial customer engagements; POCs and field trials planned this year, customer deployment expected around end FY27 or early FY28.
6G product launches expected around 2029; technology demonstrations from next year.
Inventory of INR2,358 crore reflects advance procurement for add-on orders and readiness for other customers.
demand_pricing: 5G wireless: early commercial traction internationally with TSPs; management cannot disclose site counts. Says NEC relationship makes Tejas a preferred radio partner for 5G and some 4G radios.
Wireline: steady growth from data center connectivity, residential and enterprise broadband, and utility TDM-to-IP migration.

D2M broadcast: field and lab trials completed with Prasar Bharati and FreeStream; commercial path depends on a Prasar Bharati tender that has no clear timing. Management cited a TAM of close to $1 billion if rolled out nationwide, with fewer sites than BSNL.
International payment terms are standard 60 to 90 days, with no performance-linked payment conditions.
Warranty provisions elevated due to the large BSNL rollout; management expects normalisation as the product base stabilises.

qa_highlights.question: Will BSNL acceptance tests clear and lead to receivable collection?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said acceptance tests and pending features are at an advanced stage, and a large part of BSNL receivables is expected to clear during the quarter.

qa_highlights.question: What is the path to profitability and timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited revenue growth, opex optimisation, and working capital reduction; first target is positive EBITDA and EBIT, with 12 to 18 months considered reasonable for positive PAT.

qa_highlights.question: Why did receivables rise by about INR325 crore when revenue was about INR400 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the quarter's higher shipments went into receivables and non-BSNL collections continued.

qa_highlights.question: What is the AMC opportunity from BSNL?
qa_highlights.answer: AMCs are to start after site acceptance and warranty, recognised over 8 years, awarded circle by circle as multi-year contracts; sizes not yet shared.

qa_highlights.question: What is the D2M opportunity and competitive position?
qa_highlights.answer: Only Tejas equipment has completed D2M proof-of-concept trials; the company awaits the Prasar Bharati tender and will partner with an SI such as FreeStream.

qa_highlights.question: Is the South America order a pilot or rollout?
qa_highlights.answer: It is an initial network order following a successful POC; management expects additional expansion orders as the operator grows.

risks_watch: Negative PBT and high warranty provisions tied to the BSNL rollout; watch whether warranty costs normalise.
Receivables at INR2,232 crore and rising, with BSNL collections dependent on acceptance completion.
Net borrowings of INR4,277 crore and rising working capital.
Timing of BSNL 26,000-site order, which management has repeatedly deferred; AMC revenue timing and size undisclosed.
D2M tender timing is unclear; no certainty on orders.
Order book only INR1,529 crore with 93% domestic; international conversion of wins needs to show up.
Management did not give a split of wireless vs wireline revenue.
summary.management_tone: Confident and forward-looking on international 5G traction, the BSNL order and AI-linked products, but cautious on near-term profitability, with management conceding FY26 fell short of expectations. Several answers on order sizes, AMC value and D2M timing were deferred or left unquantified.
key_quotes: And I believe we are on the path to profitability.
I would say our first target will be positive EBITDA and EBIT and then going to PAT profitability as well.
We expect a lot of the BSNL receivables to also get cleared during the quarter, as we move along for the expansion project.
So the AMC revenues would be recognized over a period of 8 years when it starts.
